description: The data grid's spoken text, language-neutral: cellLabel(parts, { messages }), detailsLabel(column, row, { messages }) and errorAnnouncement(column, row, message, { messages }) from core/src/grid/label.ts. parts.value is the value text, already formatted. messages override the English catalog per locale with the keys of core/src/i18n/messages.ts; the Italian and Arabic messages below reorder the parts, which the catalog allows. kind defaults to cell. The core tests and the Flutter tests read this file, so both implementations answer the same cases.

labels.name: an editable cell
labels.expect: Monday 6 October, PX-12 Project X, 5 hours

labels.name: an empty cell reads the empty text
labels.expect: Monday 6 October, PX-12 Project X, empty

labels.name: the secondary label after the value
labels.expect: Saturday 11 October, PX-12 Project X, 5 hours, Non-working day

labels.name: a summary cell with its badge
labels.expect: Monday 6 October, PX-12 Project X, 5, 2 entries

labels.name: every part, in the spec's order

parts.error: Enter a number that is at most 24.

labels.expect: Sunday 12 October, PX-12 Project X, 25, 3 entries, Non-working day, Error: Enter a number that is at most 24.

labels.name: a column total with an error

parts.error: More than 24 hours on this day

labels.expect: Monday 6 October, Total, 25, Error: More than 24 hours on this day

labels.name: the row header with its total
Italian puts the value first

parts.error: Inserisci un numero non superiore a 24.

labels.expect: 5 ore, lunedì 6 ottobre, PX-12 Progetto X; Giorno non lavorativo; Errore: Inserisci un numero non superiore a 24.

labels.name: Arabic puts the row first, with the Arabic comma
labels.expect: PX-12 المشروع X، الاثنين 6 أكتوبر، ٥، خطأ: أدخل رقمًا.

details.name: the details button names its cell
details.expect: Details, Monday 6 October, PX-12 Project X

details.name: Italian details button
details.expect: Dettagli, lunedì 6 ottobre, PX-12 Progetto X

announcements.name: an error on a cell
announcements.message: Enter a number that is at most 24.
announcements.expect: Monday 6 October, PX-12 Project X: Enter a number that is at most 24.

announcements.name: an error on a column total
announcements.message: More than 24 hours on this day
announcements.expect: Monday 6 October, Total: More than 24 hours on this day
